description: This file defines the interface UnretireHandler, which provides a contract for handling the 'unretirement' of objects that implement the Retireable interface in the OpenMRS API. It includes documentation about its purpose, related classes, and method signature for 'handle'.

classes.name: UnretireHandler
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for unretire actions on Retireable objects within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the unretirement process by resetting Retireable attributes to null, called around unretire methods to clear retirement data.
